*   **High Dynamic Range:** The resulting volume renderings are high dynamic range because transparency modulation can allow more light to pass through, increasing color intensity.
*   **Color Accumulation:** Unlike MIDA, IBATM does not modulate accumulated color.
*   **Importance Measure Design:** The effectiveness of IBATM depends heavily on the choice of $F$ and $B$.
*   **Time Complexity:** Linear in the number of samples per ray, $O(N)$, same as standard front-to-back compositing.
